about: Money data of the Saint Jude world package, rebuilt from Saint Jude Setting Bible Part VI (The Price Book), sections 1.1-1.5, 3.1, 4.2, 4.2A, 4.4, 4.5, 5.2, 7.3, 7.6, 7.7. Every row carries default, range, unit, year_basis, mark and tag. mark is [verified, source], [memory, to verify], [Design], [arithmetic] or a carried Part. A null default means the bible gives only a range. Design and derived figures the engine draws once per run live in design_figures.json.
